title: Earthly British Beef Cottage Pie
description: A nutty and snappy nostalgic British dish featuring beef stock concentrate, namul-blanch-season, and high protein friendly ingredients in a cottage pie form, cooked in a tagine pot.

ingredients.name: mashed potato
ingredients.notes: made with 2 large potatoes and 1/4 cup milk

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and sliced mushroom to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the beef stock concentrate and frozen peas and carrots, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the flour to thicken the mixture, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a tagine pot or a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Spread the mashed potato over the top of the mixture, and sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese.
Dot the top of the potato with butter.
Bake the cottage pie in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the potato is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
